messages:
cam_marketing: Heads-up: dry run tomorrow 11am PT. Need final confirmation on stage script, poll wording, and demo contingency clips. Also want to lock the benchmark bullet points we'll call out.
sita_prod: Available. Benchmark bullets I'd highlight: 1) median latency under 80ms for small requests, 2) 2.5x cost reduction with prefix caching + quantization for chat workloads, 3) predictable tail latency with Dedicated pools. Keep each point to one line in slides.
owen_demo: I'll be onsite with the demo rig. Plan is live request flow using Private VPC endpoint then quick switch to pre-recorded clip at 11:07 if any issue. Pre-recorded clip uploaded: https://drive.redwood/rehearsals/demo-clip-v2.mp4
tess_ops: Streaming/recording notes: cloud recorder will start at 10:50. Please join the rehearsal zoom at 10:40 to check audio. I'll hand off green/red statuses in the channel. Speaker mics: wired lapel recommended, but USB headsets allowed.
marco_growth: Polls for live audience: Q1 at minute 4: "What's your primary infra challenge?" (latency/cost/scalability/ops). Q2 quick net interest at minute 22: "Would you like a sandbox invite?" (yes/no). We'll use poll results in follow-up segmentation.
cam_marketing: Stage script (tight):
```
10:50am - Recording on, tech checks
11:00am - Welcome & goals (cam) - 3m
11:03am - Benchmark narrative & business impact (sita) - 7m
11:10am - Live demo (owen) - 10m
11:20am - Deep dive: routing + cost controls (sita) - 6m
11:26am - Panel Questions + audience poll review (owen, sita) - 12m
11:38am - CTA & next steps (marco) - 2m
11:40am - Optional office hours + followups
```
owen_demo: Demo contingency checklist:
- local copy of seed prompts + cached responses
- env var keys for PRIVATE_DEMO and HOSTED_FALLBACK set
- recorded clip ready to stream (11:07 cue)
- chrome profile preloaded with credentials + screen share permissions
sita_prod: Routing policy summary for ops to watch:
- Primary: private-stage-v3 (pinned)
- Auto-fail to private-stage-b if error rate >1.5% for 30s
- If both private unavailable -> hosted-light fallback (read-only demo)
- Alert channel: #eng-oncall on failover, with immediate notification to tess_ops and cam_marketing
tess_ops: Producer cues I'll give during the live: 1) "3-minute warning" before demo end, 2) switch to clip command when asked, 3) green/red status for speakers. I'll add short hand signals in the rehearsal zoom chat.
marco_growth: Post-webinar nurture plan (short): immediate email with benchmark PDF + recording, day 2: sandbox invite for engaged poll respondents, week 1: case study invite for top accounts. Tag leads by poll response + Q&A interest.
alert-bot: reminder: rehearsal scheduled in 14 hours. Automated resource check: private-stage-v3 capacity OK (GPU pool 4/8 free).
cam_marketing: Quick ask to panel: please keep answers concise (30-60s). If you need more time, we'll move to office hours. React with :white_check_mark: when ready.
sita_prod: \u2705
owen_demo: \u2705 demo rig staged at office B
tess_ops: \u2705 streaming + recording verified
marco_growth: \u2705 polls created and segmentation tags set
cam_marketing: Great. See you all at 10:40 for mic checks. Keeping this thread for any last-minute swaps or script tweaks.
